For a \(3\)-\(4\)-\(5\) triangle, the two pieces formed by the altitude to the hypotenuse are similar to the original with scale factors

\[
\frac{3}{5}\quad \text{and}\quad \frac{4}{5}.
\]

Thus each kept piece has expected scale factor

\[
\mu=\frac12\left(\frac35+\frac45\right)=\frac{7}{10}.
\]

The altitude of the original triangle is

\[
h_0=\frac{3\cdot 4}{5}=\frac{12}{5}.
\]

The expected length of the \(n\)-th cut is \(h_0 \mu^{n-1}\). Therefore

\[
\mathbb{E}(l)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} h_0 \mu^{n-1}
=\frac{12}{5}\cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac{7}{10}}
=\frac{12}{5}\cdot \frac{10}{3}
=8.
\]

Hence

\[
[\mathbb{E}(l)]^2=8^2=\boxed{64}.
\]
